sensitive.title: Sensitive things
sensitive.intro: Some things are more personal: your health, your money, and what you believe. I only remember those if you say yes, and you can switch each one off any time.
sensitive.healthEmpty: Nothing yet. When you mention your health, it'll show up here.
sensitive.healthOff: Health is off, so I'm not keeping health notes.
sensitive.moodEmpty: After we talk, a gentle sense of how you seemed will show up here.
sensitive.moodOff: Health is off, so I don't keep a mood timeline. I still listen for how you're feeling while we talk.
sensitive.loadError: I couldn't load these settings just now.
sensitive.agreed: Thank you. I’ll keep these close.
sensitive.on: Got it. I'll remember that now.
sensitive.deleteBody: I still have {count} things about {label}. Delete them too?
sensitive.deleteKeepsAllergies: Your allergies stay, so I never suggest something unsafe.
sensitive.forgetMoodBody: I'll forget how you seemed in that conversation.

lifeMemory.loadError: I couldn't reach that just now.
lifeMemory.workEmpty: Tell me about your work and I'll keep track of the story.
lifeMemory.placesEmpty: Where you live, where you've been, where you dream of going. It'll show up here.
lifeMemory.colleaguesHint: You can correct or forget people under Memories.
lifeMemory.title: What I remember
lifeMemory.forgetBody: I'll stop remembering "{text}" and won't learn it again from past conversations.
